parameters.name: RepoNamespaceName
parameters.description: The name of the namespace to which the repository belongs.

parameters.name: RepoType
parameters.description:
The default repository type. Valid values:

*   `PUBLIC`: a public repository.
*   `PRIVATE`: a private repository.

You can specify the RepoType or Summary parameter. The RepoType parameter is optional.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-chart-repository --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --repo-name repo01 --repo-namespace-name namespace01 --repo-type PUBLIC --summary summary --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateChartRepository --region cn-hangzhou --RepoNamespaceName namespace01 --RepoType PUBLIC --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --RepoName repo01 --Summary summary
